title: Design: Edit Customer keeps the inactive term selected
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure a customer is on Net 50 with a credit limit of $5,000.00.
  • Make sure Net 50 is deactivated.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design pictures ct-p6-03-edit-customer-today.png, ct-p6-04-edit-customer-keeps-the-inactive-term.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the customer page of that customer.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the pencil on the customer card.
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "Edit Customer" window opens with "Credit Terms" reading "Net 50 (Inactive)" and "Credit Limit" reading $5,000.00, editable, side by side after State/Province and Country (as in ct-p6-04-edit-customer-keeps-the-inactive-term.png; compare today's ct-p6-03-edit-customer-today.png).

Step 2:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-R7: “On Edit Customer, a customer whose term was deactivated shows it as "{name} (Inactive)" in the dropdown, selected, listed after the active terms.”
  • S5-R12: “The inactive term stays selected until the user picks another term.”
  • S5-R1: “New Customer shows a "Credit Terms" dropdown and a "Credit Limit" field side by side, in the same place they sit on Edit Customer.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "6 Customer on a deactivated term" ("Edit Customer today", "Edit Customer keeps the inactive term"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes, except where this held design case follows the design.
